scope: Rapid review; not exhaustive; findings are source-reported and not independently reproduced

rows.method: Weight reading, small-policy construction, car-policy and language-model repair.
rows.finding_and_limit: Car: 0/256 to 1,024/1,024 on one level; Qwen looping repaired; non-looping Gemma shows no established competence gain.

rows.method: Reconstructed the released Qwen patch and verified language-tensor hashes.
rows.finding_and_limit: MATH-500: 51.0% with four samples/problem; baseline check only 25 problems. Reproduces an artifact, not its discovery.

rows.method: Byte-level patch audit, grading checks, unedited-setting reruns.
rows.finding_and_limit: Better-configured unedited Qwen reaches 44.0%; settings and grading alter the headline comparison.

rows.method: Independent Opus repair scaling four Qwen MLP neurons.
rows.finding_and_limit: Thinking-mode gains; no consistent advantage over non-thinking base. Development-set improvements weaken on fresh data.

rows.method: Qwen and Kimi read small-policy prompts.
rows.finding_and_limit: Qwen identifies three games and misses Freeway; evidence for narrow reading, not policy repair.

rows.method: Cross-model, single-response Breakout policy construction.
rows.finding_and_limit: Reports construction across model generations; exact plotted scores were not verified in this review.

rows.method: DeepSeek identifies anonymized control networks.
rows.finding_and_limit: 3/4 correct; one confident confusion. No repaired policy demonstrated.

rows.method: 959 neural programs / 13 tasks; a separate 420-edit prediction study.
rows.finding_and_limit: Ten algorithmic tasks solved; architecture changes and language-data leakage limit scope. Raw-weight access helps only modestly in edit prediction.

rows.method: Sparse Italian-tense steering with a fitted activation direction.
rows.finding_and_limit: Nonpreferred tense rates fall; some controls break. Closed-form fitting is used; a LoRA control is competitive.

rows.method: Translation ablations and a story-model activation shift.
rows.finding_and_limit: Translation repair fails broadly; repetition falls 32% to 2% on 100 prompts, but markup worsens. Successful intervention is a runtime hook.

rows.method: Audited and repaired small synthetic decision networks.
rows.finding_and_limit: 16/18 planted defects found; only 2/5 healthy networks cleared. Simple methods compete; no clinical-readiness inference.

rows.method: Quantum-state model transfer using weight/code edits, then training.
rows.finding_and_limit: Fine-tuning and a Lanczos step contribute to strong results; editing alone trails references and does not improve the source task.

rows.method: Quantized coding-model edits plus template/harness fixes.
rows.finding_and_limit: 16/23 to 25/27 reported; changed denominator and simultaneous fixes prevent weight-only attribution.

rows.method: Proposed iterative edits for restoration diffusion models.
rows.finding_and_limit: Conjectural enhancement loop; no measured restoration improvement.

rows.method: Hash-pinned patches, regression gates, composition and rebasing.
rows.finding_and_limit: Individually useful edits can conflict; some repair paths require training. Infrastructure, not robot evidence.

rows.method: Direct UniAD driving-checkpoint edits.
rows.finding_and_limit: L2 0.942 to 0.845 m; collision 0.29% to 0.17%. Open-loop, startup-concentrated; closed-loop validation pending.

rows.method: Ten-task pi0.5 neuron edits; separate folding task-vector addition.
rows.finding_and_limit: Direct edits help 5/10 tasks; mahjong 23% to 36% (87 tests). Folding 51% to 75% uses trained model differences; final denominator unspecified.

rows.method: Protocol distinctions and simple weight-statistic controls.
rows.finding_and_limit: Reading, construction, and tool-assisted repair are different claims; require ordinary baselines and access accounting.

rows.method: Unified robot-use harness with unchanged policy weights.
rows.finding_and_limit: Performance changes with tools and observations; not a direct weight-editing experiment.

rows.method: Simulation-derived supervised training and RL.
rows.finding_and_limit: Reports real-robot transfer; training is central. Predates the WSP release, so not a replication.
